title: InfinityOS 02: a smoother desktop and fresh downloads
summary: The latest 24 hours brought new ARM64 and x64 images, direct downloads, a more capable terminal, simpler setup and fixes across gaming, NVIDIA installation and system updates.

changes.title: Fresh ARM64 and x64 images
changes.text: Both Fedora 45 and GNOME 51 live images were built and verified from the same source revision. Downloads now open the ISO directly from Cloudflare R2; filenames, sizes and MD5 and SHA-256 checksums on the website come from the verified release manifest. Future successful builds replace the published pair automatically.

changes.title: NVIDIA prepared before first boot
changes.text: On supported x64 NVIDIA hardware, installation now builds and checks the driver modules, rebuilds the boot image and updates the rEFInd copy before finishing. A failed driver setup stops installation instead of leaving the problem for the first desktop session. Network access is required.

changes.title: Steam starts reliably on desktop and TV
changes.text: Desktop Steam and TV Mode now use the working runtime launcher. TV session startup, exit behavior and installation defaults were corrected. Steam remains closed after TV Mode setup so its first update can finish from the desktop.

changes.title: A simpler first run
changes.text: InfinitySetup opens on the System tab with a centered loading message. Its search spans categories, while InfinityConfig drops its unnecessary search bar. Setup and Config retain their app icons, dock favorites appear in the app grid, and several changes applied together need only one administrator authentication.

changes.title: A more useful InfinityTerminal
changes.text: Configurable widgets add available CPU and GPU readings, timers, Pomodoro, network transfer, battery, weather and a second time zone. Monitors can be moved and are centered in the terminal. The drop-down animation now enters fully from above the screen, and its panel icon follows the active theme.

changes.title: A smoother InfinityUpdater
changes.text: The update drawer opens with a softer motion and keeps its actions readable in light and dark themes. Downloaded offline updates now trigger a notification with a localized restart action. Restart handling and update completion messages were also corrected.

changes.title: Desktop details and extensions
changes.text: Desktop icons and dock artwork are more compact, mounted-drive icons match the InfinityOS palette, and NowPlay and Raccoon Launcher are bundled. Animation fixes and native GNOME extension checks improve reliability, including with reduced motion enabled.

changes.title: News from the live desktop
changes.text: Firefox in the live installer opens this changelog, making the latest build notes available before installation.
